summary: Frontend testing of CL Messenger v3.1 features completed. Tested 7 features: Fun Channel admin-only writing, admin bots visibility, create group modal, user search, console commands /online and /delgift. All core features working as expected.

issues: Button 'Изменить подписчиков' is visible to all users but only admins can actually change the value. Consider hiding button for non-admins or adding visual indicator that it's admin-only.

fun_channel_admin_only_message.description: Regular users see 'Только администраторы могут писать в этот канал' message in Fun Channel. Message input is replaced with readonly text.

admin_bots_hidden_for_regular_users.description: Stars Bot, Отладочный Бот (Debug Bot), Gift Bot, and Config Bot are hidden from regular users (adminOnly: true in mockData.js)

admin_bots_visible_for_admins.description: After /login with admin code, all admin-only bots appear in contact list

subscriber_edit_admin_only.description: updateSubscriberCount() function checks isAdmin and shows error toast 'Доступ запрещён' for regular users

user_search.description: When typing in search, registered users are shown under 'Найденные пользователи' section with 'Пользователь' badge

create_group_modal.description: Modal has: Название группы, Юзернейм группы (min 4 chars), Аватар группы gallery, Добавить участников search

console_online_command.description: /online command shows online users count and list for admins. Shows '❌ Доступ запрещён' for regular users.

console_delgift_command.description: /delgift [name] command deletes custom gift and shows confirmation. Shows '❌ Доступ запрещён' for regular users. Implementation verified in SettingsModal.jsx lines 75-90 and ChatApp.jsx handleDeleteGift function.

admin_login_logout.description: /login hhsqs000091demyan_icqToCLxd successfully authenticates admin. /logout revokes admin status.

admin_can_write_fun_channel.description: After admin login, message input appears in Fun Channel and admin can write messages

critical_code_review_comments: All v3.1 features are correctly implemented
adminOnly flag properly hides bots from regular users in filteredContacts
canSendMessage() correctly checks for fun-channel and isAdmin
Console commands /online and /delgift have proper admin checks
User search shows registered users from cl_registered_users localStorage
seed_data_creation: None required - app uses localStorage. Test data added via localStorage.setItem for cl_registered_users, cl_online_users, and icq_custom_gifts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v3.1 features verified working. Admin code: hhsqs000091demyan_icqToCLxd. localStorage keys: cl_user_registered, cl_admin_status, cl_registered_users, cl_online_users, icq_custom_gifts. Create Group modal supports adding members via username search.

mocked_apis_list: All data stored in localStorage - no backend API calls
cl_registered_users - array of registered users for search
cl_online_users - array of online users for /online command
icq_custom_gifts - array of custom gifts for /delgift command
